identitySignals: A church directory (Bridges Bay Area) lists 'The Movement Church - Elmhurst' at 1800 98th Avenue, Oakland, CA 94603, matching the agenda name and Oakland, CA location

Search results indicate the Oakland congregation at that address became a campus of Resonate Church in January 2024, but the legal entity behind the 2020-2021 facilities use agreement could not be confirmed
The domain listed in the directory (themovement.church) now belongs to an unrelated church in Clarksville, TN, so no website can be attributed
research.notes: Legal entity not confirmed: no registry record for 'The Movement Church' in Oakland found; Resonate Church (Fremont, EIN 27-2178893) now operates a campus at the same address but the link to the 2020-2021 contracting entity is unverified. Directory website themovement.church now points to a Clarksville, TN church. Not publishable.

profile.summary: A church in the Elmhurst neighborhood of Oakland, California, listed in a regional church directory as The Movement Church - Elmhurst. Its Oakland location has since become a campus of Resonate Church.
